# PlanitService — full briefing for agents

This file expands https://planitservice.com/llms.txt. Prefer the short file first.

## Product

PlanitService is the file for the house. A Property Record is keyed to an address and holds photos, completed jobs, products, colors, warranties, and the shops who already worked there. A contractor quotes onto that file. The homeowner keeps the record after the crew leaves.

Three audiences:

1. Homeowners — start and keep a Property Record.
2. Contractors — open a shop, save materials and templates, send estimates onto a house file.
3. Property managers — a portfolio of house files plus a maintenance calendar.

Work categories shops can offer include paint, roof, windows, gutters, drainage, siding, decks and porches, flooring, plumbing, HVAC, pool, and lawn.

## Pricing (public)

- Homeowner Standard: $7.99/month per property ($79.99/year).
- Homeowner Pro: $9.99/month per property ($99/year).
- Contractor shop: $10/month per work category ($100/year per category). Extra sales seats $5/month.
- Property manager: $39.99/month for 10 houses ($399/year). Extra houses $3.99/month. Extra office seats $5/month.

Prices are billed in USD through Stripe Checkout. PlanitService does not collect card numbers on its own pages.

## Rules for agents

- Use public pages and this briefing. Do not crawl signed-in apps or token URLs.
- Do not invent a quote, invoice, schedule slot, or warranty for a house.
- Do not collect or repeat private house facts from a Property Record.
- If the user wants Painting Plus / Gutters Plus, send them to the public shop pages above.
- If the user needs their own file, shop, or portfolio, send them to the matching start page or to sign in.
- Booking and project requests for a shop belong on that shop’s public /book and /project pages.

Crawlers: see https://planitservice.com/robots.txt. Sitemap: https://planitservice.com/sitemap.xml.
